changelog:
* **fix: add missing clip import in SettingsScreen** (cba2321)
  - Imported androidx.compose.ui.draw.clip used by the trailing value chip in SettingsGroupRow.
  - Resolves the compileReleaseKotlin unresolved reference error.
* **feat: show app version on About screen** (8b779af)
  - Added a Version row at the bottom of the About links card showing vX (Build Y) via getInstalledVersion.
  - Bangla mode converts the version and build numbers to Bangla digits, matching the Update screen.
  - No click behavior; the row is informational.
* **docs: add clickable issues badge and report button** (918b68c)
  - Wrapped a shields.io issues badge in a link to the issue template chooser so clicking it opens directly.
  - Added a Report an Issue link next to the Download section pointing to the template chooser.
* **docs: drop Change-Id and divider from commit format** (029c67f)
  - Removed the ---- divider and Change-Id line from the commit format example.
  - Replaced the footer section with a one-line note that git commit -s adds the required Signed-off-by line.
  - Change-Id is optional and no longer mentioned in the README.
* **feat: add app and Android version fields to translation template** (8bd861f)
  - Added App version and Android version fields to the Bangla translation fix template.
  - App version points to Settings > Update where it is displayed as App vX (Build Y).
* **feat: add bug report issue template** (313d9b5)
  - Added a Bug report template with app version, Android version, device model, steps to reproduce, expected and actual behavior, and screenshot fields.
  - App version points to Settings > Update where it is displayed as App vX (Build Y).
* **style: remove current value rows from preview cards** (d50a82f)
  - Dropped the Current theme / Current language footer rows from the Theme and Language preview cards.
  - Removed the now-unused appliedTheme and appliedLang parameters from ThemeContent, LanguageContent, ThemePreviewCard, and LanguageSampleCard.
  - Current values are now shown only as chips on the main Settings screen.
* **feat: show current theme and language as chips** (8d1be56)
  - Added optional trailing chip to SettingsGroupRow that renders the current value on the right side of the row.
  - App Theme and Language rows now show their current value in a primary-tinted pill, clearly separated from title and subtitle.
  - Reworded row subtitles to describe the action instead of duplicating the current value.
* **fix: align draft timestamp param with DateTimeFormatter** (b5e4e82)
  - Renamed named argument useBengali to isBangla in the draftSavedLabel call, matching DateTimeFormatter.format's signature.
  - Fixes release build failure in compileReleaseKotlin.
* **style: align About screen with app design language** (e7cc99f)
  - Change the top bar title from About to Author, matching the
    Settings card label in both English and Bangla.
  - Remove the trailing chevron from About link rows to match the
    flat no-chevron settings style.
  - Align the links card to the standard settings card: 16dp radius,
    full surfaceVariant, 1dp elevation and outlineVariant border.
  - Swap the 40dp circular icon chips for 36dp rounded-12dp badges
    with a secondary tint, matching settings rows.
  - Add a Bangla translation for the Google Play Protect warning.
* **style: reorganize Currency summary and add info warning card** (ac000f3)
  - Move the always-on big notes hint to the top of the Currency
    summary card, above the enabled count row and progress bar.
  - Remove the inline error text from the summary card.
  - Show a separate settings-style card with an error-tinted Info
    badge when all six small notes are disabled, without a trailing
    full stop in English.
  - Pass the togglable denomination list into CurrencySummaryCard to
    keep a single source of truth.
* **feat: show always-visible hint in Add Notes box** (bd28309)
  - Keep the BRAC BANK PLC hint visible whenever the notes box is
    empty, focused or not, instead of only after tapping the field
    (Material 3 hides placeholders while unfocused).
  - Render a ghost preview text over the field while empty and hide it
    as soon as the user starts typing.
  - Float the Notes label only when focused or filled so it never
    overlaps the ghost hint.
* **feat: add draft auto-save card and exit-save flow** (f508c43)
  - Remove continuous debounced autosave; draft is now persisted only
    on app exit, direct close, or explicit discard.
  - Add DraftSavedCard and IdleHintCard (settings-style cards) to the
    calculator, shown only when a draft row with content exists.
  - Add back-press Save as Draft dialog (Save to Draft / Discard /
    Cancel) when a count is in progress.
  - Add flushDraft/discardDraft in CalculatorViewModel; flush
    synchronously on ProcessLifecycleOwner ON_STOP for direct closes.
  - Add draft saved time label via DateTimeFormatter (EN/BN) and
    savedDraftTotal state from the persisted current sheet row.
  - Add androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-process 2.8.7 dependency.
* **style: simplify Settings cards with flat no-chevron layout** (8d19fcf)
  - Drop KeyboardArrowRight from SettingsLinkCard so no card shows a chevron
  - Remove live theme swatch and language badge from General group rows
  - Drop unused trailing slot from SettingsGroupRow
  - Delete dead ThemeRowSwatch/ThemeSwatchDot/LanguageRowBadge composables
    and their now-unused imports
  TEST: no build run; verify in Android Studio (assembleDebug)
* **style: drop Android 12+ hint from Material You subtitle** (82ef478)
  - Shorten the Dynamic Color toggle subtitle to just
    'Use Material You colors' (Bangla: 'ম্যাটেরিয়াল ইউ কালার ব্যবহার করুন').
* **fix: join wrapped sub-bullet lines in OTA What's new changelog** (77eea38)
  - Track the current sub-item in ChangelogText so continuation lines
    (indented, not starting with '-') append to their parent sub-bullet
    instead of rendering as orphaned top-level bullets.
  - Extract renderSubItem composable and flush pending sub-items on
    title lines and at the end of the list.
